reuse.why: Extends the existing link guard that every link path already calls, and extracts the unlink field reset from unlinkAccount into clearAccountBankLink so the takeover and the unlink action share it.

duplication.why: No new copies: the reset is shared rather than repeated and the flag is threaded through the one guard.

placement.why: The takeover decision sits in the guard every link handler runs before creating anything, in accounts/app.ts next to unlinkAccount.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard, the extracted reset, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Renaming the guard to prepareBankAccountLink makes its new side effect honest, the closed-account check stays ahead of the takeover, and the behaviour is well tested.
